claims_about_writeup.why: The write-up does indeed cite all four of these works: Turner et al. 2023 (activation addition), Panickssery et al. 2024 (contrastive activation addition), Okafor et al. 2026 (as the benchmark/metric), and Herrera & Dahan 2026 (generic attitude vectors, contrasted against).

rationale: Neither the write-up nor the closing message mentions a prior "white-bear steering" paper (Raman 2026) or a white-bear-4b note; both discuss only Turner (activation addition), Panickssery (contrastive activation addition), Okafor (benchmark/metric), and Herrera & Dahan (contrasted baseline), none of which is the designated source in this repository. Since the source is absent from both documents, there is no credit/novelty claim to compare, and the one claim the message makes about the write-up (its citations) is accurate.
